title: Dubai airports came under 17 ballistic missile strikes during the conflict in th
description:
Dubai airports came under 17 ballistic missile strikes during the conflict in the Middle East, Paul Griffiths, CEO of the airport operator company Dubai Airports, has stated.

According to his data, cited by the Khaleej Times newspaper, in addition to the missile attacks, sirens sounded 111 times at the airports. 

He added that no one died as a result of the incidents, and there were very few injured, all of whom have fully recovered.

Средства будут направлены через программу закупок оружия для Украины в США на европейские деньги PURL (Prioritised Ukraine Requirements List). Лондон присоединился к ней в начале 2026 г. 

Кроме того, в данный пакет войдут артиллерийские снаряды и БПЛА. 

Все это должно быть доставлено на Украину до наступления зимы.

Однако, Зарница всегда, ещё в годы нашей советской юности, была не про войну вовсе. И даже сейчас. Да, танки, взрывы, ББМ, работа в двойках, тройках, вынести раненого, наложить жгут, дать связь, штурмовать окоп, и многое другое.

description:
Мужчина погиб в результате детонации дрона ВСУ в Белгородской области

description:

title: Germany's Interior Ministry has developed a plan to counter unidentified dro
description:
Germany's Interior Ministry has developed a plan to counter unidentified drones and cyberattacks, Bild reported. 

It includes expanding mobile federal police drone units at key airports, railway stations, and the government district, as well as allowing critical infrastructure operators to independently protect against drones, expanding AI facial recognition and video surveillance at train stations and creating a national Cyberdome system to detect and intercept hacker attacks.

title: Earlier today, two explosions occurred at the General Maintenance Center of the
description:
Earlier today, two explosions occurred at the General Maintenance Center of the RAM-2 “Bolívar” Mechanized Artillery Regiment in Viacha, La Paz Department, Bolivia.

The explosions were reported at around 2:30 PM in an area used to store pyrotechnic materials belonging to the Ministry of Defense.

At least two people were killed, 59 injured (including 52 civilians and 6 military personnel), and seven others remain missing.
